decisionsTitle: A members' race number: the club's own design for its members, the member's own choice to carry it (amending §249, §173)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-04:** «I want BVR members to have an optional special BiBs, with a special design».

**What existed.** A race number is printed by the platform (BR-REQ-038-01): `bibs-pdf.ts` draws two A5 bibs to an A4 page, `bib-image.tsx` draws the preview, both from one geometry (`bib-geometry.ts`, §338), and the club designs the bib per event in `events.bib_design` (§249, §317, §560). Every runner of an event wore the same bib. The member tick «Sunt membru al grupului {club}» is a claim (§48); since §662 an address that is a live account on «Echipa» makes the registration «Membru (verificat)».

### The decision: three parts

**1. The design is the club's, per event.** The designer («Cum arată numărul de concurs», `BibDesignPanel.tsx`) gains a last group, «Numărul membrilor»: a switch «Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu»; the members' own header, a band colour (the editor's six, or «Culoarea evenimentului») or a stored picture with its crop, through the same `BibPictureField` as the main header under the members' own field names (no second chooser, §560); and «Eticheta», one short line printed on the member's band — normalised like the footer's line (§317: composed characters, one line, only what the bib's font draws) and cut at 24 characters; empty prints «Membru {club}» / "{club} member" from the catalogue, in the sheet's language. Everything else — the name, the number's size, the small print, the sponsors, the cut marks — stays the event's one design. Stored **inside** `bib_design` as a nested `member` object (`bib-design.ts#bibMemberSchema`, strict, each field with its own `catch`), read by `readBibMemberDesign` with the same never-throw rule as `readBibDesign`: a design saved before the key existed, or a malformed object, reads as off with no colour, no picture and the default label, and prints exactly as before; a crop never outlives its picture; a key a later release adds inside it is ignored, as §317 does for the whole design. The panel's `present` marker rule holds: a form without the panel writes no design. The designer shows a second live preview of a member's bib (`?member=1` on the preview route); the editor's closed line names «număr de membru» while the switch is on. No migration for the design.

**2. The choice is the member's.** While the event's switch is on, the public form shows under «Sunt membru al grupului {club}» a second tick, «Vreau numărul de membru», ticked to begin with, with its help: the same number in the same order, only the look differs, printed only for an address the club knows as a member's. Stored in `registrations.member_bib_wanted boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false` (migration `0129_member_bib_wanted`, expand only, no back-fill). The service decides it under the event's lock off the locked row (`domain/member-bib.ts#memberBibKept`): true only when the design offers it, the member tick is on and the wish is ticked; a stale form — rendered before the switch went off, or posted with the member tick off — stores false, never refused. Every door passes there: the public form, the family forms, a restart, a staff entry (which asks the same tick when an event on its list offers the members' bib) and the desk. «Modifică datele» (§645) corrects it like any answer, through the answers allowlist (`answers.ts#EDITABLE_ANSWERS`), audited `registration.answer_corrected` `{ field: "memberBibWanted", from, to }`; clearing the member tick clears a standing wish in the same press with its own audit row, and the member-tick sweep does the same. Pre-ticked because the people who see it have just said they are members and the bib is what they asked for; a member who wants the ordinary bib unticks it. The box starts ticked on every form but one: a refused press that brought back the member tick without the wish shows the untick the person chose (`member-bib.ts#memberBibTickedAtFirst`). A prefill is never read as that answer — a family sitting's shared boxes hold no member tick (§519), and an invited member's form (§647, `invitations.ts#invitationDraft`) arrives with «Sunt membru» and «Vreau numărul de membru» both ticked.

**3. The club verifies.** A registration prints the members' bib only when it **wants** it, the event **offers** it and its canonical address is a **member account's** — the verified rule of §662 (`member-ticks.ts#memberCanonicalEmails`, read once per sheet, met with `inArray` on `participants.canonical_email`, a plain `false` with no member account, never an `IN ()`). Never the tick alone: the club's own list verifies, as §645 has it. `listBibs` returns `member` on every `BibRow`; the per-registration preview asks the same of its one row, so the bibs page's grid, the registration's bib and the desk's picture are previews of the paper.

### Why the number does not change

The number is drawn in the order of confirmation from the event's own band (§173), with the desk's spares never drawn for an online runner (§444); that order is the fairness rule a volunteer checks off at the start line. A member's bib is the same number in the same place, the same name, the same small print; only the header and one short line differ, both renderers agreeing through `bib-geometry.ts` (`memberTagTop`, `memberTagHeight`, `memberLabelSize`, `memberTagPad`): the label sits at the header's right under the race and its date, on the band itself, or on a tag of the members' colour (else the event's band) over the members' picture so it reads on any photograph. A members' picture that cannot be fetched prints the members' colour, then the event's band — never the event's picture, which would hide whose bib it is, and never a failed sheet. Spares are never members' bibs. The printed mark, the void logic and the scope of the sheet are untouched.

### Asked but unverified

A person who ticked «Sunt membru» and asked for the members' bib, whose address is no account on «Echipa», prints the **ordinary** bib. The bibs page says so in one line before printing — «Au cerut numărul de membru, dar adresa lor nu e a unui cont de membru: {count}. Li se tipărește numărul obișnuit; dacă sunt membri, adaugă-i în «Echipa» înainte de tipărire.» — with a link to the registrations list filtered to them (`memberBib=asked` with the confirmed state). The filter is the sheet's own scope — a real row with a number (`bibs.ts#bibScopeWhere`) that wants the members' bib at an event offering it, whose address is no member account's — so the line and the list count the same people; it rides with the export and the summary pills and is cleared by «Arată-i pe toți». The event's switch is read in the condition's own `EXISTS` over `events`, not through the caller's joins: the list's count and summary select no `events`, and the page must answer with the filter on. Adding the person on «Echipa» is the verification (§662); the next sheet prints their members' bib. The registration's page shows «Număr de membru» beside the race number when the row will print one, «Număr de membru: cerut, neverificat — se tipărește numărul obișnuit» when it asked and is not verified. The export carries «Member bib» = `yes` / `asked` / empty — the CSV's last column, the workbook's beside «Club member», in the export's English like every other header.

### Unchanged, on purpose

The desk shows a name, a state and a number and nothing new (§67); its bib picture is the bib that prints. The public participant list shows nothing of it (BR-REQ-039-01). The allocator and every count: the wish and the verification decide a look, never a place, a price or a position (`AGENTS.md` §12.6, §48). A TEST registration behaves like a real one in the queue and stays off the sheet as before (§30).

### Refused

- **A separate number band for members.** The order of confirmation is the fairness rule of §173; a third series beside the race's and the special guests' (§647) reopens it for a look.
- **Printing membership from the tick alone.** Anybody can tick a box; the club's own list verifies (§645, §662).
- **Fonts, free positioning, a second footer or a second sponsors' strip for members** (§249): the members' design is a header and a line, and the rest is the event's one design.
- **A label in two languages.** The label is one printed line, like the footer's line (§317); its default follows the sheet's language.

Tests: unit `registrations/bib-design.test.ts` (an older design reads as off, a wrong colour falls back, the label normalised and capped, a crop without its picture dropped, the schema the form posts), `registrations/bib-design-query.test.ts` (the members' keys on the wire and in the form, `member=1`), `registrations/member-bib.test.ts` (who wears it, the wish ticked at first on a fresh form, a family sitting and an invited member's form and unticked only when a refusal brought it back, the export cell, the label's geometry inside the band, the sheet's colour only on a member's bib and only with the switch on, the fallback colours, the label at the geometry's point with the number and the name unmoved, the picture differs); integration `registrations/member-bib.test.ts` (the form and the staff entry store the wish only where offered and under the tick, «Modifică datele» audited and cleared with the tick, `listBibs` flags only wanted+verified, a declared-only row and the TEST row, no member account, the unverified count, the export, the filter in the list, its count and its summary — a TEST row that asked kept out of all three and of the bibs page's line —, the registration's page facts), `registrations/member-bib-preview.test.ts` (the preview draws a verified member's bib and not a declared-only one, the sample with `member=1`), `cms/bib-design.test.ts` (saved and read back, a malformed object reads as off); e2e `bib-design.spec.ts` (the members' switch, colour and label redraw the members' preview; written, not run). Amends §249 (the design gains the members' header and label), §173 (one band, one order; the look may differ), §645 (one more answer) and §662 (the verified rule now decides a print).
changelogLine: - **A members' race number** — the bib designer's «Numărul membrilor» gives an event's members their own header (a colour or a cropped picture) and a short label; the form asks «Vreau numărul de membru» (ticked) under the member tick; the sheet prints it only for an address on «Echipa», with the same number in the same order, and the bibs page lists who asked but is not verified. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event whose bib design has «Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu» on, when the sheet or the preview draws a confirmed real registration that asked «Vreau numărul de membru» and whose canonical address is a live account on «Echipa», then it draws the members' header (their picture, else their colour, else the event's band) and the label «Membru {club}» or the club's own, at most 24 characters, at the geometry both renderers share; the number, its band and its order of confirmation, the name and the small print are those of the ordinary bib; a declared-only row, a row that did not ask, a spare and any row while the switch is off print the ordinary bib, and a TEST row stays off the sheet (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A bib design stored before the members' key existed, or with a malformed `member` object, reads as the members' bib off with no colour, no picture and the default label, and prints exactly as before; a members' colour that is not a hex triplet reads as none, a crop without its picture is dropped, and the label is normalised like the footer's line and cut at 24 characters (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the event's members' switch on, the bibs page shows a sample of the members' bib and, when confirmed real registrations with a number asked for it with an address that is no member account's, one line with their count and a link to the registrations list filtered to the same rows (`memberBib=asked`), whose list, count and summary all answer with that filter on; the export carries «Member bib» = yes / asked / empty (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Vreau numărul de membru» is stored only while the event's bib design offers the members' bib and the member tick is on, at every door — the public form, a restart, a staff entry — and false whatever a stale form posts; «Modifică datele» corrects it as an answer, audited `{ field: "memberBibWanted", from, to }`, and clearing the member tick clears a standing wish in the same press with its own audit row (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Vreau numărul de membru» starts ticked on the public form, on a family sitting's later forms and on an invited member's form, beside «Sunt membru» ticked; it starts unticked only when a refused press brings back the member tick without the wish (2026-10-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a members' race number: the club's design for its members, the member's choice, printed only for a verified address
